description: blueprint.model reads a flow's text into the structure a form edits. It judges nothing: an unknown key or a refused value is still shown so the person can fix it.

params.content:
id: triage
description: Sort an incoming report, then ask a person to approve the plan.
schemaVersion: 1
version: 1
lanes:
  - id: sort
    step:
      kind: model-step
      agent: investigator
      produces:
        - notes.md
  - id: approve
    step:
      kind: gate
      question: go
    on_reject:
      goto: sort
      counter: rounds
      max: 2
      then: escalate
questions:
  go:
    prompt: Approve the plan?
    answers:
      - approve
      - reject

model.description: Sort an incoming report, then ask a person to approve the plan.
